Chapter 252: The War Begins (5)
“Lady Elona!”
Elona Zipfel.
She had the eyes of a human, not a monster consumed by the Origin Stone.
She was trembling with guilt over the things she had done unwillingly, struggling with the burden of her conscience, wanting to escape, wanting to live as a human.
The Origin Stone, or the ego of the sun god, Malugia.
The enemies defined Elona in this way, but Jin and his companions saw her simply as a wounded human.
Even now, Elona's body was moving against her will. The Origin Stone had forcibly separated her to protect Kelliark.
"I'm sorry, Jin. Right now, I have no choice but to attack you. The connection with the Origin Stone hasn’t been completely severed."
However, because the separation was “forced,” Zipfel couldn’t fully control her identity.
"Can the connection be cut off?"

Jin, just like when he rescued Luntia from the void space of the Evil God, attempted to find the point of connection between Elona and the Origin Stone. However, he couldn't read it at all, even with the senses of a Genesis Knight.
“It’s impossible. There’s not much time. So listen carefully to what I say... Ugh...”
For a brief moment, Elona’s eyes transformed like the Milky Way, only to return to normal. The Origin Stone was trying to consume her identity again.
Whooo, therrrng-!
Elona's magic spear struck Jin’s flame once more. Meanwhile, Kelliark was attempting short-distance spatial jumps using the Origin Stone.

His signature magic, Space Explosion, was being indiscriminately fired near Jin and Valeria. Moreover, the Origin Stone, let out a more violent cry, shaking the battlefield, so Jin couldn't advance recklessly while protecting Valeria.
"Jin, the power spreading across this space is too immense. The Origin Stone is calculating how to summon them using that power."
"Who are they?"
"The Demon Army, Zipfel from another dimension...!"
The most powerful group of magicians formed by the 'victorious Zipples' from another dimension.

The alliance was currently unaware of the full extent of the Demon Army's combat power. They could only guess that, given their conquest of dozens, if not hundreds, of dimensions, their power must be on an incomprehensibly vast level.
"So you must retreat now. I know it might seem ridiculous for me to say this while attacking you, and it might even feel like a deception... Ugh... but you have to listen to me...!"
Elona's attacks were growing fiercer by the second. This meant that the Origin Stone was reasserting its control over her.
‘Retreat, huh.’

If the battle continued as it was, Jin was confident he could capture Kelliark. The Origin Stone seemed weak at the moment, unable to control Elona properly, and Kelliark was also unable to retreat easily due to the short distance, as the effects of the Eternal Flames were weakening the Origin Stone's manipulation and distortion abilities.
However, if the Demon Army suddenly intervened, things would change.
It didn’t sound like a lie. Jin’s insight could read no falsehoods from Elona right now.
But still, he couldn't trust her.

Judging purely on feeling would risk too many lives. That was also the reason why Jin had initially delayed the deployment of the superhumans before ambushing Kelliark. Jin had planned to face Kelliark himself first, assess the power of the Origin Stone, and then send out the superhumans.
"Valeria."
"Yes."
She was already analyzing Elona’s words using a record magic spell.
While she couldn’t definitively judge the truth like Az Mill, at least she could confirm the Origin Stone’s control over Elona.

"Please trust me, Jin. The Demon Army's goal isn’t just victory in this world. They don't care if they destroy this world! As long as you and the alliance are no longer a threat to the unified Zipfel, any method will do!"
Elona’s voice quickened. Her eyes were changing and flickering in real-time, and her voice was cracking.
"Her control is definitely broken. Though she'll be bound again soon..."
Jin nodded at Valeria’s words. It had been confirmed that Elona had spoken out of her own will, so it was time to retreat.
The unified Zipfel didn't just desire ‘victory.’

Looking at it logically, it was an obvious conclusion. They had already destroyed countless dimensions. If it was easier to simply destroy the dimension rather than have the Zipfel of this world win, there was no reason for them to choose the former. Whether through victory or destruction, as long as the outcome led to the end of the dimension, the unified Zipfel would have no more enemies. No dimension would have anyone left to resist them.

Even if they lost Kelliark and the Origin Stone of this world, it might not be a significant loss for the unified Zipfel. After all, Orgal had said that the Kelliark of this world was inferior to those from other dimensions he had encountered.
A glowing ring appeared above Elona’s head. She had once again been consumed by the Origin Stone.
Grrrrr…!

At the same time, the Origin Stone’s roar echoed. Shadow Energy, the Sun Energy, and the powers of manipulation and distortion combined with Elona’s magic. Jin stepped back, adjusting his posture as the attacks came at him from all directions.
The Eternal Flames were still burning fiercely, and the Plutonian Domination Sword was showing no signs of weakening. Bligiet seemed unable to keep up with the combined assault from Vahn and Luna.
At first glance, it appeared that the alliance was still overwhelmingly dominating the battle.

However, Jin and the others could feel it. Just as Elona had said, something foreign had seeped into the powers of the Eternal Flames and the Domination Sword. This power seemed to amplify the aura that Jin and the others had unleashed, like firewood feeding a blazing flame.
Before anyone could signal.
Jin, Vahn, and Luna simultaneously unleashed their auras. The battlefield, which had been boiling with flames, lightning, and crimson energy, cleared in an instant, revealing the collapsed tower.
The fleet also stopped their bombardment. As a result, the mysterious energy that had been trying to amplify the auras drifted aimlessly, losing its direction.
‘The Demon Army's interference between dimensions has limitations. So they will try to use this energy again in some way. It’s most likely that they will attack our alliance.’
As Jin observed the unidentified energy, Bligiet, with the Sun Energy, exploded and created an opening to retreat.
‘The Zipfel will stop their attacks here. But I can’t let that one go.’
Jin’s gaze locked onto Bligiet. He was desperately trying to fly, not missing the opportunity while the lightning and crimson energy had dissipated.

But there was no way Vahn and Luna would let him go. They had only deactivated Eternal Flames and the Domination Sword, even without their ultimate techniques, the two of them could easily pressure Bluggiet.

"Kelliark, you're a hard one to kill. But I’m sure you’ve realized by now that your time is running out. You must have also figured out that you’re nothing more than a card that can be discarded at any moment."
The Zipfel from another dimension did not hold back against the Zipfel of this world.

Kelliark had not been considering the Demon Army's support, but thanks to Elona’s recent words, he now knew his judgment had been wrong. He also realized that the Origin Stone was not calculating solely for his benefit.
"You lack the weight to become the ruler of this world. Go back and endure this shame."
Jin began retreating while skillfully defending against Elona’s attacks.

Elona didn’t actively pursue him.Not only was Kelliark's safety the priority, but it was also far more efficient to focus her energy on controlling the Origin Stone than to continue fighting Jin directly.
Since the Eternal Flames had vanished, the Origin Stone could now trigger even more powerful distortions.
As soon as Jin created distance from Elona, he could already see the space between them warping. It was the result of her distorting space to protect Kelliark.
At the same time, the strange energy sent by the Demon Army began swirling and gathering around the Origin Stone.
‘It’s condensing. Is it going to explode? Or are they trying to teleport the entire Tower of Stories?’
Either way, there was no need for the Zipfel to worry about Bligiet, whom they had already discarded.
Jin no longer hesitated about Kelliark and immediately surged towards Bligiet. Bligiet quickly realized that Jin was approaching, but there was nothing he could do.
The shining Domination Sword and the Crimson Sword were already binding Bligiet on all sides. Exploding the Sun Energy wouldn’t be enough to stop those two.

Receiving the combined assault of the three from Genesis Knight was, quite literally, an unprecedented event. As Jin caught up to Bligiet and swung his black blade imbued with aura, blood splattered from Bligiet’s back.
[Grrr...!]
“If you truly are the god who created this world, at the very least, you should never have sided with them, Bligiet.”
Another series of strikes followed, and once again, Jin's blade cut into Bligiet’s back. The wound was marked by aura and a faintly burning flame of the Eternal Flames remained.
No matter how outstanding Bligiet’s powers were, it was impossible to withstand three opponents at once. He was being forced into a corner at an alarming rate and had no place left to escape.

The Tower of Stories had already completed its retreat preparations. The Origin Stone was about to teleport the tower outside the alliance fleet's encirclement and then detonate the condensed energy from the other dimension.
"You told me to endure humiliation, Jin Runcandel..."
From afar, Kelliark observed them and Bligiet.
The energy from the other dimension that the Origin Stone had gathered.
If he exploded that power now, he wouldn’t be able to deal a fatal blow to them, but it could certainly inflict damage on the alliance’s fleet.
However, Kelliark judged that it would not be enough to shock Jin.
“Then you shall endure the guilt.”
Kiieeeek…!
The Origin Stone was protruding from the top of the tower. It then transformed into something resembling a large cannon, with the energy from the other dimension was being injected into it.
Just as Jin was putting pressure on Bligiet, he suddenly turned his head and looked in that direction. He immediately understood what Kelliark was about to do.
“Kelliark, you crazy bastard! Those are the people you and your family ruled over until recently!”
Kwahhh!
A massive beam of light shot out from the Origin Stone. The beam split the sky, but it wasn’t aimed at the alliance fleet or the Genenis Knights.
It struck the region on the right of the Sota Desert, where the former Drakka autonomous districts were located.
In other words, it was a long-range artillery strike on a civilian residential area.
This is just the beginning of the nightmare you will face countless times from now on, Jin Runcandel.
Leaving a message in the sky with the Seal of Fire, Kelliark left the battlefield.
